reference.provenance_quality: poor and circular. Verified by OCR 2026-09-01: ground_truth/1252_1000016397_76.8s_burned.mp4 reproduces the gold SRT verbatim. The 'gold' SRT, that burned render, and the (curify-studio) frame inspector's embedded gold are one translation counted three times — they agree because they share a source, not because they corroborate each other. Provenance is a single manifest string ('human-translated by Curify, verified') with no named annotator, no stated ASL qualification, no date, no method, and no second-annotator check.
reference.notes: CIRCULAR CURIFY OUTREACH TRANSLATION — this is the corpus's central reference-integrity problem. The reference was authored by Curify itself (to send back to the submitter) and is not independent of the system being evaluated. Do NOT use for absolute WER/CER claims. What DOES survive: SignCaption and this reference independently agree on the fingerspelled names 'Greg'/'Sara' — two unrelated readers agreeing on two proper nouns is real evidence those names are in the video, even though the reference is not independent for full-sentence scoring. ANNOTATION_PLAN.md's instruction not to re-annotate this video protects the wrong thing and should not be followed as-is (asl-translator/README.md, 2026-09-01).
